errors.text_span: Височината на всяка стълба на диаграмата съответства на съответното ниво на CO2 в ppm. Стълбите меродавни на стойностите са приблизително в долната част на диаграмата, където са около 260 ppm, и в горната част, където са около 460 ppm.
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the line chart as a bar chart (стълба means bar/column).
The horizontal axis range is from 800,000 to 0, not 80,000 to 0.
The x-axis labels represent hundreds of thousands of years, not millions of years.

errors.text_span: започвайки от 260 ppm в долната част
errors.evidence: The y-axis scale starts at 160 ppm, not 260 ppm.
The highest data point on the chart is approximately 415 ppm. 460 ppm is the maximum value on the y-axis, not a data point.

This is a major misinterpretation of the data. While there are fluctuations, the most prominent and important feature of the chart is the dramatic spike in CO2 levels at the end, indicating a strong upward trend in the modern era. Claiming a downward trend is factually incorrect and misleading.

The description completely fails to mention the most significant feature of the chart: the steep, dramatic increase in CO2 levels towards the present time (0), which is the main point the graph is illustrating.
The phrasing is confusing. The chart shows a time period ending in 1950 (represented by 0 on the x-axis), it does not show data from the period between year 0 and year 1950.
